title: Exact localization preserves the coefficient tensor-transitivity mate
statement: For the explicit coefficient complexes, ordinary transposed map, and exact-derived comparison isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-diagram], and the fixed derived adjunctions of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison], the mate obtained by transposing the stage comparison, extending it to the algebraic closure, conjugating by the prescribed derived tensor comparisons, and transposing under the algebraic-closure adjunction equals Q(coefficientComplexTransposedMap) followed by coefficientComplexVertexIso. This compares derivation with ordinary adjunction operations; it does not assert the underived identification with coefficient inclusion, the colimit property, or the existence of the diagram.

source.place: ExtendScalars and Constructible sections (boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsSubfield_obj, boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl_obj), and TwoColimit section (constructibleCocone_essSurjObj, constructibleCocone_homSurj, constructibleCocone_homInj, constructibleCocone_isFilteredTwoColimit); these are unproved upstream inputs

proof.text: Use the exact-derived adjunction unit factorization on the homotopy category. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh via quotientCompQhIso and apply naturality to obtain the analogous formula on actual complexes. It identifies localization of an ordinary adjunction mate with the derived mate after the exact extension and restriction comparisons.

Expand the derived tensor comparison as the composite comparison inverse followed by derivation of the ordinary tensor isomorphism. Apply mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac, using naturality to cancel exact-functor comparison isomorphisms. Thus its composite with the exact extension comparison is the localized ordinary tensor comparison.

Apply these formulas first to the finite counit at the extended complex and then to the algebraic-closure adjunction. Cancel inverse pairs in the explicit stage and vertex comparisons. The resulting equation is exactly the displayed localization of coefficientComplexTransposedMap. All formulas are valid for unbounded complexes.

theorem coefficientComplex_derived_mate_transport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {E F G : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ} (he : E ≤ G) (hf : F ≤ G)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ F)) ℤ) :
    finiteCoefficientDerivedAlgClHomEquiv X ℓ E
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) _
      ((finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ he).inv.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) ≫
        (finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ G).map
          ((finiteCoefficientDerivedHomEquiv X ℓ he
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((coefficientComplexStage X ℓ he hf).obj C)) _).symm
            (coefficientComplexStageIso X ℓ he hf C).hom) ≫
        (finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ hf).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (coefficientComplexTransposedMap X ℓ he hf C) ≫
        (coefficientComplexVertexIso X ℓ (E := E) C).hom
